config.scope: Reviewer-requested post-confirmation diagnostics on frozen models. Previously inspected test outcomes are exploratory; fresh orbits are fixed before diagnostic predictions. Oracle norm/error calibration is a diagnostic, not a learned or deployable relation. Error-conditioned subsets are descriptive and condition on a possible mediator. Probes may use compound labels for diagnostics only; no encoder/operator/readout is updated. No evidence of output independence or a natural causal mathematical-relation mechanism is presumed.

claims: fixed linear-readout invisibility, not output independence
controls: wrong donor covariance transported using known validation
wrong donor oracle-calibrated to correct norm/error per input
isotropic random donor oracle-calibrated to correct norm/error
